notes: Only archetypes validated by real samples should appear here.
Planner, brief, and generator execution are wired for the validated v1 scope.
In this file, archetype means internal coordination schema for rules-composition planning, not a new page-template catalog derived from screenshots.

archetypes.label: 流程阶段协同
archetypes.description: A stage rail or process region coordinates the current task context across the primary workspace and one or more supporting regions.

coordinationSchema.requiredInteractionRule: The stage region must deterministically drive current-step content and supporting context.

archetypes.primaryRegionRule: The primary region must remain unique and carry the page's main task completion surface.
stopRules: stop when no stable stage region exists
stop when the stage region is only decorative and does not coordinate task progression
stop when a classic detail page still remains the dominant carrier

archetypes.label: 选择明细协同
archetypes.description: A stable selection region coordinates which grouped detail content is rendered in the primary region.

coordinationSchema.requiredInteractionRule: Selection must stably drive which grouped detail workspace is rendered.

archetypes.primaryRegionRule: The primary region must not collapse into a classic table-only, form-only, or detail-only carrier.
stopRules: stop when the right or center region is still a classic table-only carrier
stop when the selection region behaves only as a filter and does not control grouped detail content
stop when the layout still fits a typical-page split variant
